name: books, postpones, and cancels an initial consultation using everyday language

turns.customer: Hi, are you taking new patients?
Is 9am next Tuesday available for an initial consultation?
Please book that 9am slot next Tuesday. My name is Thandi.
I need to postpone my appointment.
Move it to 10am on the Thursday after my Tuesday appointment, please.
I need to postpone my appoint from 10:00 to 14:00.
No cancel the 14:00 appointment for Thandi.
